content_of_post_to_answer: Do you think exercise is more important for mental health or physical health?
answer: Exercise is often more valuable for mental health than people realize, because its physical benefits are easier to measure while its psychological effects can be harder to notice. A walk may not change your fitness much, but it can interrupt hours of rumination. I've explored this connection further in other writings on my profile, if you're interested. Physical health may give exercise its measurable benefits; mental health often reveals its immediate value.
